newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Keppel Philippines Q1 net at 30 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Philippines Q1 net at 30 mln pesos.

text.p: Keppel Philippines Holdings Inc said on Friday its first quarter net rose by 20 percent to 30 million pesos.
In an advisory to the stock exchange, Keppel said the group's revenues for the first three months reached 196 million pesos.
The company did not give comparative figures.
Keppel treasurer Chee Fook Meng said that a subsidiary Kepphil Shipyard Inc registered a net profit of 14 million pesos, a decline of 11 percent from a year earlier.
He said that of Keppel's first quarter revenue, Kepphil Shipyard contributed 111 million pesos while Cebu Shipyard & Engineering accounted for 85 million pesos.
Revenue for the period was down six percent compared to last year due to lower revenue at its shipyards in Batangas, south of Manila and Cebu in central Philippines.
